data.one_liner: A Flutter library for creating shimmer loading skeleton effects with smooth fade transitions.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable rectangular and circular shimmer widgets with built-in light and dark themes. Supports staggered animation delays and configurable global animation durations to build loading placeholder screens.
use_when: You need skeleton loading screens for content placeholders
You want staggered fade shimmer effects across multiple items
avoid_when: You need complex shape morphing or custom painter-based skeletons
strengths: Includes light and dark theme presets
Supports staggered animations via delay parameters
Provides a convenient factory constructor for circular shimmers
weaknesses: Changing the animation duration globally affects all instances in the app

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick shimmer if you prefer a classic gradient shimmer sweep effect rather than fade transitions.

data.minimal_example:
FadeShimmer(
  height: 8,
  width: 150,
  radius: 4,
  fadeTheme: FadeTheme.light,
)
